## spe/evals/harness/grader.js (changed parts)

```js
function normPriority(p) {
  if (typeof p !== "string") return null;
  const v = p.trim().toUpperCase();
  return /^P[1-4]$/.test(v) ? v : null;
}

function gradePriority(output, reference) {
  const got = normPriority(output.priority);
  const want = normPriority(reference.priority);
  return {
    pass: got !== null && got === want,
    raw_exact: output.priority === reference.priority,
  };
}

// selftest additions (F7)
assert(gradePriority({ priority: "p1" }, { priority: "P1" }).pass === true);
assert(gradePriority({ priority: " P2 " }, { priority: "P2" }).pass === true);
assert(gradePriority({ priority: "P5" }, { priority: "P1" }).pass === false);
assert(gradePriority({ priority: "" }, { priority: "P1" }).pass === false);
assert(gradePriority({ priority: "p2" }, { priority: "P1" }).pass === false);
```

The grader still records raw_exact, so the lowercase rate stays visible.
